concepts.description: A structural unit of the system that encapsulates functionality and data.
A physical or logical platform that performs robotic tasks within the system.
A defined set of interactions or communication points between system components.
A component that manages or directs the behavior of other components in the system.
A basic data type predefined by the system, not composed of other types.
A user-defined data type composed of multiple fields or elements.
A signal or action that can be triggered or handled through an interface.
A callable unit of code that performs a specific computation or action.

instances.description: The main module representing the AUV system.
The robotic platform component of the AUV system.
An interface used by the AUV_Platform to access sensor data.
An interface used by the AUV_Platform to control actuators.
A controller responsible for operator-related functions in the AUV system.
An interface used by the AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
A controller implementing the Last Response Engine functionality.
An interface used by LRE_Ctrl to produce output signals.
A controller responsible for autopilot functions of the AUV.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing textual data.
A primitive type representing true/false values.
A primitive type representing real (floating-point) numbers.
A composite type representing a spherical vector with radial, polar, and azimuth components.
A composite type representing an obstacle with relative position, depth, ID, and heading information.
An interface defining input events for task control and data requests. Note: likely typo for 'Inputs'.
An event signaling the end of a task with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting OCM (possibly Operational Control Mode) with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting MOM (possibly Mission Operation Mode) with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting HCM (possibly Human Control Mode) with no parameters or return value.
An event requesting velocity, returning a real number.
An event requesting heading, returning a real number.
An event to advance velocity, taking a real number parameter.
An event to advance heading, taking a real number parameter.
A composite type representing close proximity data with horizontal and vertical CDA and an ID.
A function that computes the Euclidean distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the horizontal distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the vertical distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
